action-command.intent: Commands are immutable tenant/goal/plan/principal-bound intents; authorization_context binds identity version, revocation epoch, delegations, rules, classification and access digest. Lease epoch/fencing and retry vocabulary never prove execution.
action-command.implementation_missing: Local simulated admission is not the canonical action-command model: all canonical fields, digest canonicalization, reference resolution, atomic fresh policy/identity reservation and real adapter lease enforcement need integration proof.

claim-transition-event.intent: Each claim transition carries prior/result revisions, from/to epistemic vocabulary, actor, time, rule, reason and evidence/counterevidence. Valid endpoint enums do not authorize an edge.
claim-transition-event.implementation_missing: SCF decisions/inbox persistence are not the canonical append-only claim-transition-event lifecycle; full edge matrix, monotonic revision and evidence/reference guards remain unproved.

claim.intent: Claim epistemic, verification, confidence, world-time and record-lifecycle axes stay orthogonal. Whole-schema conditionals require a confidence method, passing procedure/ref for verified and failed procedure/refutations for refuted.
claim.implementation_missing: Local SemanticClaim/SCF v1 is a subset with different shape; canonical nine-status transitions, all revision provenance, named verification, reference authorization and historical migration must be integrated and tested.

delegation-grant.intent: Delegation has explicit resource scope (at least resource_refs or resource_classes), bounded capabilities/uses/time and revocation epoch. Grant cannot exceed grantor authority; enum alone cannot reactivate revoked/exhausted authority.
delegation-grant.implementation_missing: Tenant capability grants do not implement canonical issuer/grantee delegation provenance, epoch CAS, validity windows and concurrent bounded-use lifecycle.

deletion-request.intent: Deletion is a tenant/requester-bound multi-store workflow. Scope enumerates authoritative/events/replicas/projections/vector/cache/exports/derived claims/backups; legal holds and per-target receipts govern partial versus verified completion.
deletion-request.implementation_missing: Projection tombstones/retention and explicit restore reapplication cover only owned rows; canonical requester authority, per-target deletion receipts and all-store/backup enforcement are missing.

evidence-record.intent: Integrity metadata is separate from source truth and content; tenant, classification, retention, capture/record time, lifecycle and redaction are required. Hash/signature metadata alone does not authenticate a source or resolve retention.
evidence-record.implementation_missing: Local ledger hashes and secure-completion evidence are partial: canonical evidence manifests, independent trust anchors, key revocation and lifecycle-aware reference resolution/all-store deletion need integration.

execution-receipt.intent: Append-only receipt attempts distinguish accepted/started/possible/observed/verified/pre-effect failure/unknown/reconciliation/compensated. Conditional branches require reconciliation for uncertainty, evidence for outcomes, and independently attributable verifier for verified.
execution-receipt.implementation_missing: Local simulated receipts and queue statuses differ from canonical receipt lifecycle. Complete real-adapter attempt state machine, independent verifier identity, all transition guards and authoritative effect-absence evidence remain unproved.

goal.intent: Stable goal ID plus revision has tenant/requester/owner, explicit desired outcome and criterion methods/evidence kinds. Completed requires independent criterion proof; final states cannot reopen in place.
goal.implementation_missing: Local criterion enforcement/atomic completion are partial; all canonical goal fields, states, terminal/blocked transitions, authorized evidence resolution and migration need exact contract integration.

health-signal.intent: Health is tenant/scoped source telemetry with observed_at and fresh_until. Healthy/degraded/unhealthy/unknown/stale are diagnostic, never repair authorization; stale/unknown cannot become healthy by omission.
health-signal.implementation_missing: Local HAL freshness/observe-only tests cover a subset; canonical signal shape, clock/skew profiles, telemetry authenticity, operational SLOs and distributed signal integration remain open.

message-envelope.intent: Transport envelope is separate from payload contract and carries explicit principal/tenant/correlation/classification/schema identity. Commands additionally require recipient/idempotency/expiry; responses require causation.
message-envelope.implementation_missing: WireEnvelope is a signed local contract, not this canonical envelope. Canonical dual schema-version enforcement, payload registry/migration, authenticated tenant/principal mapping and cross-host operation remain incomplete.

observation.intent: Observation records what a scoped authenticated source emitted; capture and receive timestamps, payload digest/ref, provenance and classification do not prove interpretation truth.
observation.implementation_missing: Runtime Observation shape is not canonical Observation: tenant/source authority, provenance/digest references, classification handling and exact schema integration are unproved.

policy-approval.intent: Approval/rejection binds actor/approver/action/scope/side-effect digests, identity/policy/epoch and validity. Deny requires rejected; approve excludes rejected; single-use=1 and bounded-use>=2. Schema cannot enforce cross-field use_count<=max_uses or real approver authority.
policy-approval.implementation_missing: Existing approval checks/single-use SQLite reservation are partial; all canonical issuer/action-context fields, bounded use, authorized approver signatures, revocation and atomic cross-store dispatch binding remain incomplete.

policy-decision.intent: Immutable decision permits/denies/requires approval/defers for exact principal/action/policy/rules/identity/epoch/expiry. Approval-required is not mutable permit; approval triggers a new evaluation.
policy-decision.implementation_missing: Local policy dictionaries are not canonical policy-decision tokens. Full context digest, current authoritative identity/policy epochs, token verification and external-effect TOCTOU proof remain open.
